differences.expected: the original structured-text roadmap might allow one shared Schema mode for JSON, YAML, XML and TOML
differences.actual: JSON Schema, YAML/TOML projection and XML XSD have different standards, trust and resolution boundaries
differences.correction: select only the standardized local JSON/JSONC foundation and keep YAML, TOML and XML out of M7-1

differences.expected: existing syntax diagnostics may already cover business constraints
differences.actual: valid but business-invalid samples produce zero diagnostics and production schema integration tokens are zero
differences.correction: separate syntax truth from optional schema truth and require explicit diagnostic provenance

differences.expected: a remote schema URI could provide the quickest provider experience
differences.actual: remote resolution introduces trust, cache, offline, privacy and reference-expansion risks
differences.correction: M7-1 forbids network access and automatic remote resolution; only a deterministic local sibling sidecar may be evaluated
